content: Home Manager official docs confirm the sharing pattern: same home.nix imported in both worlds. NixOS path: home-manager.nixosModules.home-manager with home-manager.users.<name> = ./home.nix and extraSpecialArgs = { inherit inputs; }. Standalone path: home-manager.lib.homeManagerConfiguration { pkgs = nixpkgs.legacyPackages.X; extraSpecialArgs = { inherit inputs; }; modules = [ ./home.nix ]; }. extraSpecialArgs is the documented mechanism to pass flake inputs to both. The flake-parts chapter additionally shows homeModules.<name> reusable modules + sharedModules option for per-user common imports. Cross-checked: HM manual nix-flakes/{nixos,standalone,flake-parts}.md on master.
